what: A paper-grain curtain page transition that burns open and covers like spreading ink. Clicking a link to another page makes the curtain spread from outside the bottom left of the screen (-.16, 1.16) over 2.8s sine.in to cover it, navigating at 94%, and the arriving page, still covered, is revealed in place over 2.8s sine.out. The edge is stained by distance from the origin + twisted noise (.28), the spread width narrows .075 → .038, and a wide band (.068 → .034) and a thin capillary band (.022 → .011) around the edge are tinted in the accent color (strength .08, off for the first and last 8%). The curtain has paper grain: fine grain ±.012 and coarse blotches ±.007. It can also be called separately, for example fx:ink-play opens it from the center after the loader.

options.cover: Cover length after pressing (sec), default 2.8 — shorten it for app-like frequent flipping
options.reveal: Time to clear on the arrived page (s), default 2.8
options.at: At what fraction covered the next page is called, default .94
options.x · y: Bleed start point (0–1 from the top left of the screen, can be outside), default -.16 · 1.16
options.first: On first open without a transition — reveal (starts covered, then uncovers, default) · wait (stays covered waiting for fx:ink-play — after the loader, does not block input) · none (no cover)
options.links: If off, link presses are not intercepted (only via fx:ink-play)
options.--fx-paper · --fx-rim · --fx-rim-deep ·: Curtain color, band color, dark thin-line color, stacking order (via style), default --kf-bg · --kf-accent · --kf-accent-text · 9999
options.fx:ink-play: Event sent to the element — detail { direction: cover|reveal, dur, ease, x, y, seed, edge, block (default true — blocks interaction while running. The opening after the loader is false), onProgress(p), done() }
options.fx:covered · fx:revealed: Events fired from the element when fully covered and when fully uncovered. For pages that arrive by a page turn <html> fx-ink-arrived is added (when the loader is skipped)

use: <body data-fx="ink-paper-veil"> — To open in the center behind the loader, use data-fx-ink-paper-veil="first: wait" Left as is, and when the loader ends, fx:ink-play is added to body { direction: 'reveal', dur: 5.6, x: .46, y: .44, ease: 'sine.inOut' }
note: The original is a single-page app, so it swaps the body at 94% cover and reveals right away (total transition 5.6s, phone 5.4s). The part uses normal navigation, so it loads the next page once covered, and the new page starts covered and then reveals — in between, it stays covered for as long as the page takes to load.

from.where: shared.js page transition·opening after the loader (original InkTransition — cover 2.8s sine.in · reveal 2.8s sine.out · origin GL(-.16,-.16) · edge .08 · seeds 763·967·1441·1487 per section, after the loader 5.6s sine.inOut origin GL(.46,.56))
